title: Veggie Stir-Fry with Potatoes
description: Try this vegan-friendly stir-fry as a side dish or hearty main event; potatoes instead of noodles make this meal a little different.
ingredients: 2 pounds red potatoes, cut into bite-sized chunks
3 tablespoons soy sauce, or to taste

steps.text: Place potatoes into a large pot and cover with salted water; bring to a boil. Boil on medium-high heat until tender but still intact, about 15 minutes. Drain.
Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add onion; cook 1 minute. Reduce heat to medium-low; add pea pods, then add cooked potatoes and increase heat to medium. Cook 5 to 7 minutes more.

Add bok choy, bean sprouts, and spinach. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low; cook about 5 minutes. Add soy sauce and ginger. Cook, uncovered, until liquid evaporates and spinach wilted, about 5 minutes more; season with salt.
